messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Dutch, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Dutch line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | **mosse** | the initial moment / first hour of the time (noun) | **uur** | “hour” | OK | | **di** (line 40) | preposition “of” (genitive) | **van** | “of” | OK | | **prima** | “first” (adjective) | – | – | **MISSING** | | **quelle** | demonstrative “those” (plural) | – | – | **MISSING** | | **cose** | “things” (collective noun) | **seizoen** | “season” | OK | | **belle** | “beautiful / sweet” (adjective) | **zoete** | “sweet” | OK | | **sì** | adverb “so, thus” introducing result clause | **zodat** | “so that” | OK | | **ch'a** | conjunction “that” (part of “so that”) | **zodat** | “so that” | OK (combined with *sì*) | | **bene** | adverb “good” (modifying hope) | **goede** | “good” | OK | | **sperar** | infinitive verb “to hope” | **hoop** | “hope” | OK | | **m'era** | clitic + copula “to me was” (experiencer) | **bij mij** | “to me / at me” | OK | | **cagione** | noun “occasion, cause” | **aanleiding** | “occasion” | OK | | **di** (line 42) | preposition “of / concerning” | **van** | “of / concerning” | OK | | **quella** | demonstrative “that” (singular) | **dat** | “that” | OK | | **fiera** | noun “wild beast” | **beest** | “beast” | OK | | **a** | preposition “with” (instrument/attribute) | **met** | “with” | OK | | **la** | definite article “the” (feminine) | **de** | “the” | OK | | **gaetta** | adjective “dappled, speckled” | **gevlekte** | “dappled” | OK | | **pelle** | noun “skin” | **huid** | “skin” | OK |
### Items Needing Attention - **MISSING**: *prima* (first) and *quelle* (those) are not rendered in the Dutch translation. - No **WRONG**, **GRAMMAR**, or **UNNECESSARY** items were identified.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Dutch script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Dutch text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 40: - Original: `het uur van de tijd en het zoete seizoen;` - Issue: missing **prima** (“eerste”) and **quelle** (“dat”) - Corrected: `het eerste uur van de tijd en dat zoete seizoen;`
- Line 41: - Original: `zodat het een aanleiding was voor goede hoop bij mij` - Issue: none - Corrected: `zodat het een aanleiding was voor goede hoop bij mij`
- Line 42: - Original: `van dat wilde beest met de gevlekte huid.` - Issue: none - Corrected: `van dat wilde beest met de gevlekte huid.`
